title: saxifraga aizoon subsp. neogaea
intro: Saxifraga aizoon subsp. neogaea, commonly known as the alpine saxifrage, is a plant species native to the high-altitude regions of the Andes mountain range in South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, digestive issues, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. Saxifraga aizoon subsp. neogaea contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
